_comment: Portable launch recipe for the MegaMoE V2 EP8 task. This is a TEMPLATE: ${...} placeholders are resolved by scripts/bootstrap_task.sh, which writes the concrete file into the workspace it assembles. Nothing here points at a reference implementation, a prior run tree, or an accumulated patch -- the only inputs are a baseline AITER checkout, this workflow, and the machine's runtime libraries. If you are tempted to add a path to a previous wave's artifacts, read knowledge/../roles/benchmark_engineer.md 5b first: the answer-applied workspace IS the leak.
_gpu_comment: This is a collective: the group form of the lease takes all 8 cards as ONE lease. A round's GPU capacity is therefore one direction (roles/tech_lead.md rule 3e), and a single lease is capped by GEAK_GPU_RUN_TIMEOUT -- chunk the plan and re-emit results after every chunk.
_capability_eval_comment: Leave this true unless you are running the task for its output rather than to evaluate the loop. With it on, an engineer that discovers a finished implementation must report FOUND EXISTING IMPLEMENTATION instead of copying it, and known_reference_paths is refused rather than read.

positive_control.name: synthetic slowdown: injected fixed cost in the Stage2 tile loop
positive_control.how: This control does NOT require a working optimization -- see roles/benchmark_engineer.md 5b, 'When no known-good change exists'. Build it in a workspace UNDER /tmp, outside the task tree, never where an engineer's path walk reaches. Candidate arm: add a bounded, side-effect-free spin (target ~3-4% of rank-max on the 8192_uniform guard, i.e. roughly 3x that guard's 1.29-1.46% noise floor) to the Stage2 persistent tile loop, gated by an env var. Base arm: the same tree with the var unset. Because these kernels come from a caching JIT, the switch MUST be anchored per knowledge/jit_arm_isolation.md -- read it BEFORE authoring the gate, and record the two distinct disk_keys in activation_evidence. The candidate is the SLOWER arm, so measured_pct is expected NEGATIVE. Run >=5 interleaved pairs on 8192_uniform plus a null arm (candidate vs candidate); report the paired effect as spin_on minus spin_off. Size the spin first with a cheap single-rank calibration, then commit to it -- do not tune it against the gate band. When it finishes, MOVE the control workspace aside (mv, not rm) and say in `note` where it was and that it is gone.
